predictionSkill.meaning: Skill = 1 − model squared error / baseline squared error on identical non-initial samples; positive is better, negative is worse. Zero baseline error has undefined skill. No challenge-based model selection.
predictionSkill.limitations: No-learning references are not physical laws. Initial angle/rate are supplied; recording independence is not authenticated. Results describe these recordings, not generalization guarantees.

limitations: Finite-library angular-acceleration models; physical inertia and absolute torque remain unknown.

A supplied initial angular rate is used for prediction. Compact-window weak fitting does not use that rate.
Challenge observations do not enter fitting, ranking, or initial velocity estimation.
Inspecting challenge errors and choosing settings is exploratory reuse, not a new blind validation.
Source kinds and acquisition independence are declared by the input author, not authenticated.
Numerical step error, calibration error and missing physical structure can all affect forward error.
